item.title: Ex-wife and boyfriend sue Springfield surgeon, alleging repeated access to medical records
item.description: SPRINGFIELD, Mo. — A Springfield-area doctor is being sued by his ex-wife and her boyfriend, who say he repeatedly looked up their medical records through CoxHealth systems without a valid reason and later used private information to allegedly embarrass them and cause financial harm. item.title: Ending the month chasing records
item.description: Mild temperatures have made a comeback, with highs in the 50s and 60s, and even warmer days ahead, before a cold front moves in Saturday night and a quick shot of colder weather follows mid-week.

item.title: Communities across Southwest Missouri grieve after two Christian county deputies killed in ambush
item.description: SPRINGFIELD, Mo. — Communities across southwest Missouri are grieving after two Christian County deputies were shot and killed during what investigators describe as an ambush. A Webster County deputy was also injured. The suspect was later found dead. item.title: Christian County Sheriff remembers fallen deputies Michael Hislope and Gabriel Ramirez
